snippet.title: Kazu the Cassowary - Official Teaser Trailer | 3D Platformer
snippet.description:
Meet Kazu! 🐦🇦🇺

Introducing Kazu the Cassowary, an upcoming 3D action-platformer inspired by the golden age of platforming adventures!

Journey across the Australian Outback as Kazu sets out on an adventure to rescue his parents. Explore colorful environments, overcome challenging obstacles, battle enemies, discover hidden secrets, and collect Feathers and Opals along the way.

🌏 What to expect:

* Classic 3D platforming with modern gameplay mechanics
* Diverse Australian environments, from beaches and rainforests to snowy mountains and dangerous swamps
* Exciting chase sequences, challenging enemies, and boss battles
* Hidden collectibles, secret routes, and replayable levels
* An original adventure starring Kazu the Cassowary!

🎮 Platform: PC (Steam first)
🚧 Status: In Development
🎬 Video: Official Teaser Trailer

Developed by Kodybod Studios.

Follow the development of Kazu the Cassowary for future gameplay reveals, trailers, announcements, and release information!

If you’re a fan of classic 3D platformers, subscribe and follow Kazu’s adventure!

#KazuTheCassowary #IndieGame #3DPlatformer
